original_test_intent: Run `stress-ng --cpu 225 -t 8h` on the SUT and verify post-stress usability with complete CPU, thermal, power, kernel and BMC evidence.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Install stress-ng, clear dmesg, run 225 CPU workers for eight hours, then inspect dmesg.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: System remains workable and produces no unexpected errors.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Changed the workload to all CPUs for 600 seconds.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restored 225 workers/eight hours and rejected dmesg clearing.
historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; preserved the full source workload and readiness/safety gates.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer approves the project worker count, runtime, thresholds and maintenance window; execution and evidence collection can then be automated.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 225 CPU workers for 8 hours; attended 30 and machine 500 minutes are retained planning values.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Approved worker count, runtime, affinity, thresholds and tool version.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A shorter or differently sized approved project run can complete that project plan but must report the missing 225-worker/eight-hour master coverage.

original_method: `stress-ng --cpu 225 -t 8h`; preserve full output and logs without `dmesg -c`.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prefer an existing approved project stress/cycle wrapper only when it invokes the approved stress-ng workload and retains full telemetry/evidence.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record the installed project-qualified stress-ng version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: stress-ng installed-version help/manual plus project test plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: A wrapper may add monitoring and lifecycle control; it must not silently change workers or duration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Any parameter change is an explicit project override.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sustained thermal/power load and host unresponsiveness; official defaults are not assumed.

safety_boundaries: No unapproved package or production workload impact.
Stop only at approved safety/data/control limits; ordinary warnings are retained while collection continues.
expected_evidence: Full stress output/exit status and elapsed time
no_automatic_retry: Preserve the first failure or early stop. Do not restart with fewer workers, shorter duration or changed flags unless separately approved; the next pre-approved loop is not a retry.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent records Actual versus project plan and master coverage; engineer decides formal outcome.
review_improvement: V3.1 corrects V3's wording that treated 225 workers/eight hours as fixed except source revision. They are preserved Master Defaults, while an engineer may approve a project override with an explicit coverage delta. Safety and evidence requirements are unchanged.
